verdict.rationale: jo's docs say you can 'give jo a job and a schedule' and receive a weekly plan, morning priorities, or a weekend review 'without asking each time.' Its always-on cloud machine lets it work overnight and prepare results before you wake, and those results reach you via macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp, or email. missing for 10: explicit documentation of one-off (non-recurring) scheduled tasks, detail on how schedules are created and managed, independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled jobs run reliably.
